metadata.methodology:
Values transcribed from the rendered Pay versus Performance table in each company's latest DEF 14A filing, using per-ticker manual column maps verified against the filing HTML. The four compensation columns were cross-checked against Inline XBRL facts (ecd:PeoTotalCompAmt, PeoActuallyPaidCompAmt, NonPeoNeoAvgTotalCompAmt, NonPeoNeoAvgCompActuallyPaidAmt); all 488 company-years passed with zero rejections through wave 10. TSR columns show the value of an initial fixed $100 investment. Units vary by filer and are recorded per company; compensation normalized to dollars. Fiscal-year filers (PG, HD, COST, ORCL, WMT, CRM, DIS, CSCO, INTU, PANW, NKE) show the year as filed. JNJ files two peer TSR series (S&P Pharmaceuticals and S&P Healthcare Equipment); AMZN files two peer TSR series (NYSE Technology and S&P Retail). PLTR lists no company-selected measure; its CSM fields are null. NOW files two peer TSR series (2025 peer group and prior peer group); Citi (C) files net income in $B. C (2021), TMUS (2025), NKE (2025-2026) show multiple PEOs with per-executive XBRL member verification. MU (fiscal filer, Aug yr-end), CAT (CEO change May 1 2025, Creed+Umpleby 2025), AMAT (fiscal filer, Oct yr-end; neg. PEO CAP 2022), MRK (net income filed in $000s; Davis+Frazier 2021), PM (Calantzopoulos+Olczak 2021; CSM = currency-neutral adj. diluted EPS growth %), RTX (Calio+Hayes 2024-2025; neg. Hayes CAP 2023), GEV (2 PvP years only, spun off Apr 2024).
